question: What division of eight groups of eight is sought to be known fully?
premises: There is a division of eight groups of eight
The speaker seeks to know it fully
The knowing is sought without limit
inference: The speaker seeks complete and endless knowledge of the division into eight groups of eight
uncertainties: The exact referent of the eight groups of eight is not specified in this verse
plain_english: I seek to know fully and endlessly the division into eight groups of eight.
